title: Autopilot worker outcome
description: The control-flow envelope a supervised Claude worker writes before it exits. It is NOT a second evidence store: a lane's own work is still reported through .claude/rules/lane-handoff.schema.json and cited here by path. Orchestration consumes this file; the prose a worker prints is for humans and is never parsed for control flow. A missing or invalid file is FAILED, never DONE - the safe direction.

sessionId.description: The Claude session id this worker ran under, so a rotation can resume it if recovery needs the prior context.

task.description: Which supervisor action produced this worker. Mirrors the `pnpm flow next` action that caused the launch.

node.description: The graph node this worker owned. Absent for gate tasks that span a wave or phase.

outcome.description: DONE: the task is finished and its evidence is on disk. REPAIR_REQUIRED: a bounded, diagnosable failure the supervisor may redispatch. BLOCKED: a CLAUDE.md escalation trigger fired - `trigger` and `options` are then required. ROTATE: context exhausted or a clean boundary reached; the same task continues in a fresh worker. FAILED: the worker could not complete and could not classify why.

summary.description: One line for a human reading `pnpm autopilot status`. Never parsed.

commit.description: The commit this worker produced, when it produced one.

handoff.description: Path to the lane handoff (.artifacts/handoffs/*.json) or the session continuation brief. DONE on a dispatch task requires one.

evidence.description: Artifact paths that bear on this outcome. Paths, never pasted content.

trigger.description: The CLAUDE.md ## Plan discipline escalation trigger number, 1-6. Required when outcome is BLOCKED.

options.description: The materially different courses of action the human is being asked to choose between. Required when outcome is BLOCKED.

detail.description: Captured output, verbatim, when it is short. Anything long goes to an evidence path instead.
